name: app-black-orange-home-management-phone-on-ribbed-ledge
title: Black and Orange Home Management Phone
whatItIs: A tilted black phone on a pale ribbed ledge against a grey gradient, showing 'AI Home Management' with dark device cards and an orange metallic air cooler card, room tabs and a pill nav with an orange home button.
whatItMeans: Orange on black feels warm and premium, and one lit card shows which device is active.
techniques: One orange card among dark cards
Pill nav with an orange active circle

vocabulary.definition: The one card styled in the accent colour to show it is on.
A gradient that imitates shiny metal.
